title: The pain of an empty Heart
author: Nilima Bora
text:
The red blood of my heart
Hed long turned into rocks of pain ,
Those rocks of pain in my heart
are too heavy to carry .
A shattered glass house in chest ,
Mental anguish , life`s turmoil ,
The agonizing cry of the heart `s chamber .
A trembling , entangled knot .
Thus , hidden within the deep abyss ,
It weaves through the web of sorrow .
An empty heart today ,
Sighing breaths ,sighing mind , sighing body .
The echo of sorrow resonates in the heart`s depths .
A peculiar agony in this sigh .
The pulsation of the heart grows silent and
fades away .
I become still ,
In the emptiness of the heart ,
it creates the sigh .
Those shattered fragments .
Transform into scattered syllables ,
Merging into the rhythm of my experience .
Each ripple of poetry
Forms a necklace of words.
In the garland of waves .
My soul finds its expression .
The inspiration to survive .
